title: Histopathological Diagnosis of Adenomyosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to develop and evaluate a hysteroscopic endo-myometrial biopsy for diagnosing adenomyosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* females complaining of pelvic congestion: dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, chronic pelvic pain, menorrhagia, metrorrhagia

Exclusion Criteria:

* refusal of the patient to get enrolled in the study
